searchText: Quick announcement: I have just updated the hive rpc-compat tests with an improved chain, additional tests, and improved matching that allows for differing error messages across clients Another improvement to disable 'exact matching' on the result is in the pipeline. Most failing rpc-compat tests on hive2 are now actual spec deviations, or at least things worth discussing. I'll try my best to open issues in client repos, but you are also encouraged to check results yourself on hive2
